name: vuesp.hw364
summary: HW-364 OLED display with SSD1306 graphics and ScriptRunner LCD functions.
description:
## Vuesp HW-364

ESP8266 project for the HW-364 OLED module with an SSD1306 128x64 display connected over I2C (SDA 14, SCL 12).

ScriptRunner exposes the `lcd`, `show` and `clear` functions, and the `$display` variable can be used to print values from automation scripts. The standard Vuesp dashboard, GPIO, Wi-Fi and OTA features are included.
